tom_marketing: Quick ask 9: single-side field handout comparing security, SLA, and recommended deploy modes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) for regulated prospects. Keep it scannable.
alyssa_product: I'll draft product bullets: compliance posture, data residency, isolation guarantees, latency/throughput expectations.
ben_sales: Add pricing/commit cues under each mode  AEs always ask about capacity and contract lead time.
maya_ds: Call out quantization vs accuracy for Dedicated/Private; customers worry about heavy quantization.
tom_marketing: Structure: left quick-decision flow, center 2-row comparison table (controls + SLA), right short use-case blurbs. No long paragraphs.
alyssa_product: Draft bullets: Hosted  fastest time-to-value; TLS + encryption at rest; shared runtime; platform SLA 99.9% (typical p50 <2s). Dedicated  isolated GPU pools; tenant network isolation + private vnets; 99.95% SLA; reserved capacity pricing (monthly/annual). Private  customer-managed VPC or on-prem; KMS/HSM + audit logs; highest compliance (SOC2 + custom), SLA negotiable + PS installation.
ben_sales: Flow suggestion: <100 qps + strict PD/KMS -> Private; 100-1k qps -> Dedicated; prototyping/low compliance -> Hosted. Add procurement notes: Dedicated/Private require procurement lead time + contract.
maya_ds: Technical notes: prefix caching & batching lower per-token cost for Hosted and Dedicated; Private needs tuning during install. Fallback: auto-route to compatible variant on capacity outages.
tom_marketing: Sales checklist: DPA/SOC2, network peering info, expected traffic patterns, retention/PII requirements, contact for security review.
alyssa_product: Tiny FAQ: "Mix modes?" -> Yes, hybrid routing supported. "Model versioning?" -> Pin + canary rollouts supported.
tom_marketing: Assign: alyssa (copy), ben (sales checklist + contract durations), maya (tech blurbs). Deadline EOD.
deploy-bot: uploaded /files/2065432199-field-compare-draft.pdf
ben_sales: quick pass done; adding monthly vs 12/36 mo examples.
tom_marketing: great. I'll layout and post final PDF here when ready :thumbsup:
